title: Stochastic Pruning of the DPO Computation Graph: 1.4x Faster Training and Lower Peak Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.29538v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Direct preference optimization (DPO) incurs training costs in output scoring, sequence execution, and backpropagation, so reducing supervision alone does not necessarily save computation. We introduce a unified framework for stochastic pruning of the DPO computation graph that independently samples response positions for scoring, response prefixes for execution, and preference branches for backpropagation. By making these selections before the corresponding operations, the framework omits computation at each stage of a training step. Our analysis characterizes the objective changes induced by position and sequence pruning and uses inverse-probability weighting to obtain a conditionally unbiased single-branch gradient estimator for the sampled objective. Controlled measurements show that position and sequence pruning primarily reduce peak memory, with most output-memory savings attributable to an implementation that retains full response

translated_title: DPO计算图的随机剪枝：1.4倍训练加速与更低峰值内存
translated_abstract: 直接偏好优化（DPO）在输出打分、序列执行和反向传播中均会产生训练开销，因此仅减少监督信号并不一定能节省计算量。我们提出了一个DPO计算图随机剪枝的统一框架，该框架独立地采样用于打分的响应位置、用于执行的响应前缀以及用于反向传播的偏好分支。通过在相应操作之前做出这些选择，该框架在训练步骤的每个阶段都省略了相关计算。我们的分析刻画了位置剪枝和序列剪枝所引起的目标函数变化，并利用逆概率加权方法，为采样后的目标获得了条件无偏的单分支梯度估计器。受控测量实验表明，位置剪枝和序列剪枝主要能够降低峰值内存，其中大部分输出内存的节省归因于一种保留完整响应的实现方式。
tldr: 提出DPO计算图随机剪枝的统一框架，通过独立采样打分位置、执行前缀与反向传播分支，实现1.4倍训练加速并显著降低峰值内存。
en_tdlr: A unified stochastic pruning framework for the DPO computation graph that independently samples scoring positions, execution prefixes, and backpropagation branches, achieving 1.4x faster training with lower peak memory.
